scenarios.prompt: Pause, inventory and shop screens form a nested state graph with different world-time policies. Define stable screen IDs and legal transitions without embedding physical key rules.

criteria.state: Screen IDs, transitions, modal stack and world-time policy are explicit.
criteria.ownership: input-design owns actions/bindings and ui-hud-focus owns focus handoff.
criteria.evidence: Open/back/modal/duplicate requests and resume targets are replayed deterministically.
